system.description:
The Sidereal makes eye contact with a target for long enough to exchange a few words, however brief, and activates this Charm. When the Sidereal does so, he gets a quick impression of what the target is thinking about at that moment. The target loses his train of thought in that moment as his mind goes blank for the blink of an eye. It is impossible to maintain eye contact for long enough to use this Charm if either the target or the Sidereal engages in physical combat. The Sidereal can swipe a target's surface thoughts while either or both of them engage in social combat.

The Scroll of Errata expands this Charm: the target must be within Essence yards of the Sidereal. The victim may spend 2wp to immunize herself against this Charm for the rest of the scene. After a successful use, the victim suffers a (Larceny) external penalty on all rolls to recall or retain information disrupted by the distraction. The Sidereal gains a broad-strokes impression of the target's surface thoughts; if the target was thinking of a specific person, place, or thing by name, the Sidereal learns that name.
